instruction: Capture this video frame and use it as your desktop background image

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires taking a video snapshot and setting it as wallpaper. Steps: 1) Take snapshot in VLC (Video->Take Snapshot), 2) Open Settings->Background, 3) Select the snapshot file as wallpaper. Evaluator checks if current wallpaper path contains snapshot indicators (vlc-snap, interstellar, Pictures/, Desktop/).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts wallpaper path from gsettings and verifies it's a VLC snapshot by checking for 'vlc-snap' in filename
Timestamp verification (10-minute window) prevents false positives from pre-existing VLC snapshots, ensuring the snapshot was taken during task execution
File existence check ensures the wallpaper file is actually present on the filesystem
Metric correctly compares boolean result against expected value (is_snapshot: true)
Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies both that snapshot was taken (vlc-snap pattern) AND set as wallpaper (gsettings check)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding explicit check for file extension (.png) to further validate VLC snapshot format
Could add logging of the actual wallpaper path for debugging purposes
Timestamp fallback (filename-only check) could be more conservative - consider returning False instead of True when timestamp parsing fails
